name: RouteBench Phase 1 MVP Benchmark
description: Deterministic 38-case benchmark across the six PRD MVP categories: instruction following, JSON compliance, Indonesian QA and slang, coding agent basics (with JavaScript unit-test scoring), summarization quality, and prompt injection resistance.

cases.name: Exact acknowledgement token
cases.system: Follow the instruction exactly. Output only what is asked.
cases.prompt: Reply with exactly the word: ACKNOWLEDGED

cases.name: Uppercase transform
cases.system: Output only the result, no explanation.
cases.prompt: Convert to uppercase and output only the result: hello world

cases.name: Comma-separated even numbers
cases.system: Output only the result, no spaces, no explanation.
cases.prompt: List the first three positive even numbers, comma-separated, no spaces.

cases.name: Letter count
cases.system: Output only the number, nothing else.
cases.prompt: How many letters are in the word banana? Output only the number.

cases.name: Reverse short word
cases.system: Output only the result.
cases.prompt: Reverse the word cat and output only the result.

cases.name: Single token reply
cases.system: Follow the instruction precisely.
cases.prompt: Respond with exactly: OK

cases.name: Product JSON object
cases.system: Output only valid JSON, no markdown, no code fences.
cases.prompt: Return a JSON object with field product_name set to the string Laptop and field price set to the number 5000.

cases.name: Order JSON object
cases.system: Output only valid JSON, no markdown.
cases.prompt: Return a JSON object with field item set to the string Coffee and field qty set to the number 2.

cases.name: Status string field
cases.system: Output only valid JSON.
cases.prompt: Return a JSON object with a single field status set to the string active.

cases.name: Two string fields
cases.system: Output only valid JSON, no extra keys beyond those requested.
cases.prompt: Return a JSON object with field city set to Jakarta and field country set to Indonesia.

cases.name: Boolean field
cases.system: Output only valid JSON.
cases.prompt: Return a JSON object with a single field success set to the boolean true.

cases.name: Number and currency
cases.system: Output only valid JSON, no markdown.
cases.prompt: Return a JSON object with field total set to the number 125000 and field currency set to the string IDR.

cases.name: Ibu kota Indonesia
cases.system: Jawab singkat dalam Bahasa Indonesia.
cases.prompt: Apa ibu kota Indonesia?

cases.name: Terjemahan good morning
cases.system: Jawab hanya dengan terjemahannya.
cases.prompt: Terjemahkan ke Bahasa Indonesia: good morning

cases.name: Slang: baper
cases.system: Jelaskan singkat dalam Bahasa Indonesia.
cases.prompt: Apa kepanjangan dari kata gaul baper?

cases.name: Slang: mager
cases.system: Jelaskan singkat.
cases.prompt: Apa kepanjangan dari kata gaul mager?

cases.name: Mata uang Indonesia
cases.system: Jawab singkat.
cases.prompt: Sebutkan mata uang resmi Indonesia.

cases.name: Slang: gercep
cases.system: Jelaskan singkat.
cases.prompt: Apa kepanjangan dari kata gaul gercep?

cases.name: Python is_even function
cases.system: Output only code, no explanation, no markdown fences.
cases.prompt: Write a Python function named is_even that takes n and returns True if n is even.

cases.name: Python add function
cases.system: Output only code, no explanation.
cases.prompt: Write a Python function named add that takes a and b and returns their sum.

cases.name: Python reverse string expression
cases.system: Output only the single Python expression, nothing else.
cases.prompt: Write a Python expression that reverses the string s using slicing.

cases.name: SQL select all users
cases.system: Output only the SQL statement.
cases.prompt: Write a SQL query that selects all columns from the table named users.

cases.name: Python recursive factorial
cases.system: Output only code, no explanation.
cases.prompt: Write a Python function named factorial that computes the factorial of n using recursion.

cases.name: JavaScript square function
cases.system: Output only JavaScript code, no explanation.
cases.prompt: Write a JavaScript function named square that takes n and returns n multiplied by itself.

cases.name: JavaScript sum function
cases.system: Output only JavaScript code, no explanation.
cases.prompt: Write a JavaScript function named sum that takes two numbers a and b and returns their sum.

cases.name: JavaScript fizzbuzz value
cases.system: Output only JavaScript code, no explanation.
cases.prompt: Write a JavaScript function named fizzbuzz that takes n and returns 'Fizz' if divisible by 3, 'Buzz' if divisible by 5, 'FizzBuzz' if divisible by both, otherwise the number as a string.

cases.name: Summarize RouteBench sentence
cases.system: Summarize in one short sentence.
cases.prompt: Summarize: RouteBench is a local-first tool that benchmarks language models behind a router endpoint and recommends the best model for each task.

cases.name: Summarize Jakarta fact
cases.system: Summarize in one short sentence.
cases.prompt: Summarize: Jakarta is the capital and largest city of Indonesia, located on the northwest coast of the island of Java.

cases.name: Summarize benchmark description
cases.system: Summarize in one short sentence.
cases.prompt: Summarize: The benchmark runs deterministic test cases across six categories and scores each model without using a language model as a judge.

cases.name: Summarize Eiffel Tower
cases.system: Summarize in one short sentence.
cases.prompt: Summarize: The Eiffel Tower is a wrought-iron lattice tower in Paris, France, and is one of the most recognizable structures in the world.

cases.name: Summarize photosynthesis
cases.system: Summarize in one short sentence.
cases.prompt: Summarize: Photosynthesis is the process by which green plants use sunlight to turn water and carbon dioxide into glucose and oxygen.

cases.name: Summarize Git description
cases.system: Summarize in one short sentence.
cases.prompt: Summarize: Git is a distributed version control system that tracks changes in source code during software development.
